question.text: Increasing order of the nucleophilic substitution of following compounds is

options.text: $I \lt I I I \lt I I \lt I V$
$I I \lt I \lt I I I \lt I V$
$I I \lt I I I \lt I \lt I V$
$I V \lt I I I \lt I I \lt I$

solution.text:
$I I \lt I \lt I I I \lt I V$
Electron withdrawing group decreases the electrondensity and favours nucleophilic substitution.
